scope: DMR1 v1-new (depth_merge_split), its build session only
hardware: one NVIDIA L40S, secure cloud, at most $1.11/h, 150 GB container disk, no network volume

position_at_proposal.note: one reading of the ledger (SE.live_position) for the cap and the balance; committed rose $1.1346 since 10:25Z as V1 attempt 2's last billing rows posted (no resource existed)

terms.basis: RI-LM1's statistics pass (117 s for 14 blocks) and assignments (178 s each on the pod's CPU), V1's merge (8 min for 29 blocks); the bound doubles each compute step and takes V1's init (in) and the new init's verify (out) at the 2.6 MB/s floor x 1.25

money_rules.own_envelope: its own grant; the envelope counts only this kind's runs; SOB1's closed grants' remainders are void and fund nothing here
money_rules.balance: the provider balance must cover the hard cap plus the reserve at issue and at launch; a top-up is not a grant
money_rules.teardown_reserve: $1.00 held outside the ceiling, never issued

decision: Maintainer, 2026-11-29 (review of 76e1ff5e, after the final-placement fix c90e6417): "本轮执行范围确定：先完成 v1-new 的构建、单种子完整恢复训练、评测和收尾，然后交给我 review。V2-D、V2-M、V3 暂缓。暂时不合入 main。…上述修复和验证完成后，批准以下两个独立 kind 的 grant，并允许启动对应会话：dmr1_split_build — v1-new 构建，累计支出上限 $4.30，关闭预留 $1.00；dmr1_split_train — v1-new 单种子恢复训练及评测，累计支出上限 $35.94，关闭预留 $1.00。本次合计最多 $42.24，包含两份关闭预留。预计费用合计 $19.69。所有 attempt、修复和接管产生的费用都计入各自 grant 的累计上限，重试不产生额外授权。项目总上限保持 $1,161.06，本轮不提高上限、不充值。签发和启动前重新读取实时账本、余额及资源状态；符合既有预算门控后继续。本次授权只覆盖 v1-new，不覆盖 V2-D、V2-M、V3，也不覆盖额外存储购买。…优先使用提案中的单张 L40S…本消息没有授权换卡。"
